title: AutoNation Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call and Audio Webcast Scheduled for Friday, July 31, 2026
summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), today announced that it will release its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, on Friday, July 31, 2026 before the market opens. AutoNation management will discuss these results and other information regarding the Company during a conference call and audio webcast that same day at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The conference call may be accessed by telephone at 833-461-5787 (Conference ID: 436930872) or on AutoNation’s investor relations website at investors.autonation.com . The webcast will also be made available on AutoNation’s website following the call under “Events Presentations.” About AutoNation, Inc. AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs.
